title: Angelique Special 2
overview:
In a mysterious space on the far side of the dimensional corridor, there existed only a faintly glowing sphere. A sphere with a vague will, growing through the power of the Guardians. The new queen declares that she will hold the queen's examination once again, and chooses two girls who can sense the sphere's will. Why did the queen choose new candidates? And what is the true nature of the sphere...? With its mysteries still hidden, the queen's examination now begins once more...

- Depending on the heroine's personality settings, the way characters talk, their expressions and even their whispers of love change.
- As in the previous game, several collaborators appear in addition to the nine Guardians. Unlike the Guardians they are ordinary humans, but they came to the Sacred Land specially because of their outstanding abilities. They are so attractive you can't help but admire them.
- Exchanging presents and letters, the happy dilemma of being caught between two men, date scenes where you can feel your hearts grow closer each time... the joys of romance have expanded even further.
- A mysterious creature called a "Sacred Beast," which conveys the will of the mysterious sphere, also appears, making the story even more dramatic. The secrets of this universe and world, ruled for generations by the queen and the Guardians, may also be revealed...?
- Romantic animation in the opening, ending, events and more is greatly increased in volume! The Guardians' outfits are also all new, showing a different kind of appeal.

次元回廊の向こう側にある、不思議な空間には、淡く輝く、球体だけが存在していました。
おぼろげな意思を持ち、守護聖の力で成長する球体。
新女王は、ふたたび女王試験を行うと宣言し、球体の意思を感じ取れる少女たち二人を選び出します。
女王が新たに候補を選んだ理由は？
そして球体の正体は……？
謎を秘めたまま、今また、女王試験がはじまります――

♥主人公の性格設定によって、話し方や表情、愛のささやきも変わります。
♥前作と同様9人の守護聖のほかに、数人の協力者が現れます。守護聖とは違って普通の人間ですが、その卓抜した能力ゆえに特別に聖地にやってきた彼ら。思わず憧れを抱いてしまうほど魅力的です。
♥たとえばプレゼントや手紙のやりとり、二人の男性の間に挟まれたちょっと嬉しい悩み、回を重ねるごとに心が通い合うのがわかるデートの場面……恋愛の楽しみがいっそう広がりました。
♥謎の球体の意思を伝えるという不思議な生物“聖獣”も登場し、展開はさらにドラマティックに。女王と守護聖によって代々治められてきたこの宇宙と世界の秘密も、明らかになるかも……？
♥オープニングやエンディング、イベント等でのロマンティックなアニメーションも格段にボリュームアップ！守護聖たちの服装も一新。また違った魅力が見られます。
